chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus, from Al-Qasim ibn Suleyman, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Indeed, Ali (peace be upon him) would make the son of the brother inherit with the grandfather the inheritance of his father.

key_terms.يُوَرِّثُ: He causes to inherit / He grants inheritance

ai.seo_question: How does the grandfather inherit alongside the nephew in Shia Islamic law?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi records Imam Ali’s (peace be upon him) practice of allowing the paternal grandfather and the nephew (son of the brother) to inherit simultaneously, a position that distinguishes Shia jurisprudence from the Sunni view where the grandfather often excludes the nephew. It underscores the principle that the grandfather does not necessarily block the nephew's share, reflecting a more inclusive distribution of the estate. This ruling is foundational in the Shia school of thought regarding the hierarchy of heirs in the absence of direct descendants.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from Al Qasim Bin Suleyman, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abullah<sup>asws</sup>
having said that Ali<sup>asws</sup> would make a son of the brother (nephew) inherit with the grandfather, the inheritance of his father’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Yunus from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad ibn Sulayman who has narrated the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
Ali, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, would make the son of a brother to inherit the share of his father with a grandfather.’”
